name: erp_inventory_adjustment_create
description: Post an inventory adjustment that changes quantity on hand by adjustQtyBy for one item at one location; adjustments that would drive stock negative are rejected (POST /services/rest/record/v1/inventoryAdjustment)

item.description: Item id / SKU being adjusted, e.g. HW-DFA-200.

location.description: Adjustment location (adjLocation): Newark DC, London DC or Frankfurt DC.

adjust_qty_by.description: Signed quantity delta (adjustQtyBy); negative decreases stock.
